name: A quiet summons

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Thomas recruits an adventurer to meet Bishop DeLavey privately.
description: At the Cathedral of Light, Thomas asks for an adventurer who can keep a matter private. He names no cause in the open square; only Bishop DeLavey waits inside Stormwind Keep. The request is small in sound and large in implication: someone within the kingdom has chosen discretion before disclosure. The investigation begins with a sealed threshold, not a public alarm.
